contract.actor: the existing single retained native video codec thread and capacity-one request channel
contract.input: shallow-cloned canonical IMAGE plus reduced frame rate, checked H.264 sequence limits, caller stream, scratch, and cancellation
contract.native_lifetime: the H.264 MP4 session, AVIO output, suite borrow, and every FFmpeg pointer remain on and drop on the actor thread
contract.portable_output: one exact-length contiguous rank-one CPU U8 Tensor plus dimensions, reduced frame rate, frame count, SHA-256, eight-bit YUV420P identity, and no alpha

test_cases: LTXV preprocessing, VP9 alpha, AV1, and H.264 owned-byte materialization execute serially on one non-caller actor thread
the H.264 request preserves IMAGE storage identity, reduced rate, limits, stream, scratch, and cancellation
the returned H.264 Tensor is Send plus Sync, CPU U8 contiguous, exact length, content-digest bound, eight-bit YUV420P, and non-alpha
scratch is zero before the successful response while backend resident bytes remain until Tensor drop
pre-materialization cancellation and backend allocation exhaustion remain owned by the shared portable-byte materializer
